# ScopeFlux

> ScopeFlux is an English-language expiring domain discovery and domain expiration checker at https://scopeflux.io. Browse upcoming domain drops across 16 extensions, review estimated release dates and original sources, and save domains to a watchlist.

ScopeFlux helps people research domains approaching deletion or registry auction. It is a discovery and monitoring tool, not a registrar or backorder service. Domain drop dates are estimates or source-reported events, not guarantees of availability. Owners can renew, and third parties can acquire names at auction or release. Verify availability and final terms with a registrar or registry.

## Main pages

- [Expiring domains and upcoming domain drops](https://scopeflux.io/): discover approaching releases for .com, .net, .org, .io, .app, .info, .co, .me, .xyz, .biz, .us, .pro, .cc, .tv, .sk and .cz; filter by extension and other criteria.
- [Domain expiration checker](https://scopeflux.io/check-domain): look up public registration status and expiration information via RDAP; see a projected drop date when supported by a source.
- [How domain expiration works](https://scopeflux.io/how-it-works): renewal grace periods, redemption, pending delete and release; differences between TLD processes.
- [Domain data sources and coverage](https://scopeflux.io/sources): sources, refresh behavior, coverage limitations and interpretation of estimates.
- [About ScopeFlux](https://scopeflux.io/about): project overview.
- [Contact](https://scopeflux.io/contact): questions or corrections, hello@scopeflux.io.
- [Privacy](https://scopeflux.io/privacy): privacy and account information.

## Additional application views

- [Recently expired domains](https://scopeflux.io/#recent): source-reported deletions and release estimates from the past seven days, displayed as an interactive application view rather than a separate canonical web page.
- [Watchlist](https://scopeflux.io/#watch): personal saved domains; optional sign-in.

## Where the data comes from

- Dynadot public backorder listings: projected release times for supported generic and country-code TLDs, including .com, .net, .org and .io.
- CZ.NIC: official .cz registry auction information.
- Backorder.sk: .sk deletion-day listings; exact release times are estimated.
- RDAP registry services: public registration information for individual domain checks.

Coverage is partial and source-dependent; the catalogue is not a complete registry zone or authoritative availability database. Source refreshes and domain status can change.

## Site discovery and interpretation

- [XML sitemap](https://scopeflux.io/sitemap.xml): canonical public URLs.
- [robots.txt](https://scopeflux.io/robots.txt): crawler access rules.
- Prefer the canonical pages above when citing ScopeFlux; do not treat URL fragments such as `/#recent` as separate indexable pages.
- Do not describe a listed domain as guaranteed to drop or guaranteed available. The term *expired* is not synonymous with *available to register*.

## Data access

Public interactive pages are intended for visitors. Automated use of the domain API may be rate-limited; API routes are excluded from search crawling in robots.txt. Please use the interface or contact hello@scopeflux.io about data access.
